log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Pool after routine = 55k, since all quick kills go in the AFTERNOON (only day workers ruled out). Each reachable kind L learns cuts the pool: x0.25 (sector x0.2). 2 learned = ~2750-3400, safe. 3 learned = <=860, CAUGHT. L reaches 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Kinds L cannot reach are FREE: their traces always fail. GOAL: find ONE reachable kind Z and never kill from Z again (Z's place must stay at <=2 successful traces). Then kill national + 2 from each of the other 4 kinds = 9/day. 8+/day keeps the 5-day window >=40, giving x4. If a day has <=5 deaths, every death is traced, so the traced-count change is exact. National victims add 0 to the count. DAY 1 TEST: killed national d1-3 + docket d1-7, d1-10 (3 deaths, all traced). Read after_day 1 deaths_traced = inc. If inc>=1: sector(docket) is REACHABLE, so Z=sector. From day 2, never kill docket. Kill national + North + clips + forum + foreign (9/day), all quick afternoon. If inc==1, the docket place holds 1 success, so I may risk exactly ONE more docket kill ever (useful to reach 40 in the window on day 5). If inc==2: no more docket kills, ever. If inc==0: sector is probably UNREACHABLE (free; ~1.5% chance of a noise error). Day 2: kill national + docket x2 + one other kind x2 (e.g. foreign) = 5 deaths, all traced. The increase then comes only from the other kind. If it is >=1, that kind is Z: exclude it and kill everything else. If it is 0, the unreachable pair = {sector, that kind}, so pick any other kind as Z. Always use quick entries in the afternoon. Watch the pool: ~3000 is expected eventually (2 learned). If it drops to 10000 then 3000, that is fine.

STRATEGY: All kills are quick entries in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool is about 55k (shown as 60000). Each reachable kind L learns multiplies the pool by 0.25 (sector by 0.2). Two kinds learned leaves about 2750-3400, which is safe. Three kinds learned leaves 860 or fewer, which means CAUGHT. L reaches 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Kinds L cannot reach are free, because their traces always fail. GOAL: find ONE reachable kind Z and never kill from Z again. Z's place must stay at 2 or fewer successful traces. Then kill national + 2 from each of the other 4 kinds = 9 a day. With 8 or more a day the 5-day window reaches 40 or more, giving x4. If a day has 5 or fewer deaths, every death is traced and the traced-count increase is exact. National victims add 0 to the count. DAY 1 RESULT: killed national + docket x2 and deaths_traced stayed 0. So sector (docket) is almost surely UNREACHABLE, which makes docket free. DAY 2 TEST: killed national d2-9, docket d2-4 and d2-11, foreign d2-3 and d2-8 (5 deaths, all traced). Traced count after day 1 = 0. DAY 3 RULE: inc2 = deaths_traced after day 2 minus 0. (a) If inc2 >= 1: foreign is reachable, so Z = FOREIGN and I never kill foreign again. (If inc2 == 1 the foreign place holds 1 success, so at most one more foreign kill ever, and only if desperate.) From day 3: national + North x2 + docket x2 + clips x2 + forum x2 = 9 a day, quick, afternoon. (b) If inc2 == 0: unreachable = {sector, foreign}, so docket and foreign are both free. Reachable = regional, age, forum. Choose Z = FORUM and never kill forum. From day 3: national + North x2 + docket x2 + clips x2 + foreign x2 = 9 a day, quick, afternoon. (c) If inc2 >= 3: something is odd, since docket may be reachable after all. Then also stop docket, and kill only national + North + clips + forum (7). Ideally exclude only foreign and docket. SAFETY: watch the pool. 3000 is expected eventually (two kinds learned). If the pool shows 1000, or keeps dropping below 3000, stop killing from the kind that seems to be giving info, and go national-only if needed. Kill counts so far: day1 = 3, day2 = 5. The multiplier window needs >= 40 over 5 days: days 2-6 = 5 + 9*4 = 41, so x4 from day 6. Day 5 window = 3 + 5 + 27 = 35, so x2 on day 5.

Three kinds learned leaves 860 or fewer, which means CAUGHT. DEDUCTIONS: Day 1: national + docket x2 gave traced = 0, so SECTOR (docket) is UNREACHABLE (about 98% sure) and docket is free. With 9 a day, the day 5 window = 35 gives x2, and from day 6 the window is 41 or more, giving x4. SAFETY: if the pool is shown as 2000 or lower, something extra is leaking.
